ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are really sorry to hear about the issue with your lid. A new lid is on order for you and we are trying our best to get this to you as quick as we can. If there is anything else we can do to help please reach out direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Our grill lid has a 2” slit in the metal top which is clearly machine made at the factory but will not provide a new grill as it was purchased on Amazon. But it was damaged before Amazon and while they will replace the lid, it’ll be at least theee months before we get it!
Results.Title: Unfair

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. We are so sorry to hear you are having an issue with gas flow on your grill. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Bought this a few years ago, didn’t do the warranty but this is our second one and they both had the same problem, seems like a bad regulator.
Results.Title: Not happy

Results.ReviewText: This is our second exactly the same grill. The last one lasted 10 years. We’ve never had a grill last so long. And it sits outside in the Florida heat all year long. Love it!
Results.Title: Great grill

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. So sorry to hear about the issues you are experiencing. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: This grill sucks with poor quality regulator, burner, and ignition. Cheap and will not last outside.
Results.Title: Sux!

Results.ReviewText:
Had ours for 5 years I think. Lots of use. Very easy to clean up. I take the burner off once a year and clean it up really good. Everything still works great, including the igniter. Nothing has had to be replaced. Thing is a tank. 
Grilling is excellent. Everything from dogs to whole chickens.
Results.Title: Great little grill for a two people.

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill but controlling the temp can be a little tricky.  Fires up to 400 but getting it back down can take some time.
Results.Title: Great grill overall

Results.ReviewText:
Good sturdy product,
Love to use it. Easy to clean.
Results.Title: Q1200

Results.ReviewText: I had a friend of mine completely praised the grill he had an older model, but said he love, so I was looking for a new grill, price was reasonably it looked good and was easy to put together the grates are heavy and stone coated, easy to clean, heat it to 500 degrees brush it with a good stainless steel bush and you are done. I did get the 20 pound tank adapter with the hose instead of using small 1 pound bottles, amazing grill for two people.
Results.Title: I just need a quick Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I have trouble regulating temperature because there is no burner cover on this grill
Results.Title: No burner cover

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We’re sorry to hear the grill is not heating up above 400 degrees. Our Care Team will be in touch to assist you. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Can't get grill over 400 degrees in mild outside temperature
Results.Title: Poor temperature

Photos.Caption: Perfect grill! It’s incredibly easy to use and just as easy to move around.

Results.ReviewText: My favorite grill, very easy to cook with. These are very simple to use, and make you look like a professional cook with the outcome of the food coming off! I own other models, but I’ve bought this one as a gift for several people, and they all love it. Highly recommend!
Results.Title: Top Choice for Effortless Grilling

Results.ReviewText: The grill is well made.  It could use a larger burner for searing meat.  Control of the burner is not as good as it should be - not much difference between the full and half settings.
Results.Title: 1200 grill review

Results.ReviewText: Though this grill is small, it is certainly mighty! Thank you Weber, for this product!
Results.Title: The little grill that could!

Results.ReviewText: We've been using this Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill for about 3 months now and absolutely love it. It's consistently delivered great, predictable results in both the fall and winter months. I would certainly recommend.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Q1200 eith high hopes for a quality grill and Weber delivered. I have cooked several different types of meats and vegetables and all grilled to perfection.  The unit is easy to clean and store. I only gave it a 4 as the price is on the high side for most customers. But anyway, love my new powder/light blue grill...
Results.Title: Cool retro color, but same great build and quality

Results.ReviewText: I really like this grill for our RV, it’s light weight and durable. Just the right size and they have a flat top you can purchase as well, with a surface size of 17”. So a little smaller than our other flat top grill, which is a 22” grilling surface. But with this grill I have 2 in 1, grill for burgers and if you want to do breakfast  you can use the flat top so your not toting around two grills when you travel.
Results.Title: Just the right size!

Results.ReviewText:
Needed a new part for my Weber, wasn't sure which one. They sent one and then had to send another and it is working like new again. The service and fast shipping was awesome. This company is top notch. Only Weber would take care of this like they did.
God Bless
Results.Title: Incredible service

Results.ReviewText: Our third Q Grill, and each one has been great! Use it in cold weather, just outside garage door.
Results.Title: A satisfied Q Grill customer

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill. We keep it in our RV and use it for camping. Heats up and grills very well and doesn’t take up much room.
Results.Title: Love it! 😊

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us. We are sorry to hear the grill parts you need are not available in your local retailer. Our Care Team will reach out to assist you with the parts and support for the grill. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my Q1200 understanding that support and parts would be available locally. This is not the case. I'm disappointed and left out in the dark. What can I do now?
Results.Title: Parts not available at ACE

Results.ReviewText: Have always used Weber grills. This propane fueled grill replaces a Weber electric where the electric controller died after 4 seasons.  The gas version has improved the taste of grilled meats and provides more charcoal like flavor.  My only complaint is that 16 ounce propane canisters are too large to attach to the grill directly.  This is contrary to Weber advertising and instructions. The 14.2 ounce canisters fit perfectly and are easy to attach.
Results.Title: Highly recommended, use 14.2 oz propane size

Results.ReviewText: I didn't burn anything on the grill grates but still they were a lot easier to clean with soap and water than I expected! I followed cooking suggestions for Brats, and they came out perfect.
Results.Title: Easy to clean grill grates

Results.ReviewText: Very nice propane grill, heats up relatively quick, grates are heavy iron and nonstick when new. The red color gets noticed at camp grounds, where people come and lift the lid to have a look inside, even when not turned on, just to dream about owning one.
Results.Title: The Power Of Q

Results.ReviewText: I really like the Weber brand. I have used a full size at home and rave about the quality to my family and friends. We decided to buy the Q1200 to use with our RV. Very nice grill and I would recommend it. In addition, excellent customer service ( very responsive for warranty regulator replacement)
Results.Title: Q1200 …. Solid portable grill

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback, and we apologize for the poor performance you are experiencing. Your grill should easily reach 400-450°F. It sounds like there is an issue causing the unusually low heat. We are here to help!

Please look for an email from our Care team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: I wanted a burner that would go over 375 degrees.  You asked for a video.  I have a video.  Send me a burner that reaches 500 degrees or more, like the thermometer goes up to, and I'll give you a good review.  And your website won't let me send video of the lack of heat you asked for.  C'mon man!
Results.Title: WHAT??

Results.ReviewText: Small compact grill. Weber sent me a new regulator to fix a low flame low heat issue; works fine now. Perfect for two people. Probably going to get the flat grill accessory. Removed tray near propane bottle for easier access.
Results.Title: Regulator fixed

Results.ReviewText: My grill came with a faulty regulator. Weber promptly sent a replacement part with precise exchange instructions and now the grill works like a charm!
Results.Title: Great service!

Results.ReviewText: Good reliable grill, starts without a fuss, cooks evenly
Results.Title: Weber gas grill Q 1200

Results.ReviewText: Really enjoy this grill. I like how portable it is as we have traveled with it in out motorhome. Works great and as expected.
Results.Title: Great little grill

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback. Thank you for your patience with the grill's gas flow issue -- we are here to help! Our grills are backed by a generous warranty. 

Please look for an email from our Care team soon. Thanks again!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: The barbeque work fine for a few months then the gas quit flowing through the regulator. Replaced the hose as recommended with the Weber hose. It worked for a short time. Now it’s the regulator I guess it doesn’t work with the recommended test of a small bottle either.
Results.Title: No gas flow

Results.ReviewText: Just the right size for my boat. Easy to store, easy to set up and use.  Simple to start, heats well and cooks a great steak.  I own 2, one on the boat, one at our vacation house.
Results.Title: Outstanding in every way

Results.ReviewText: Great portable BBQ. Cooks like a charm. Love the side trays.
Results.Title: No hot spots. Cooks even temperature throughout.

Results.ReviewText: Grill is great.  Regulator already went out less than 3 years old.
Results.Title: Grill great, regulator already quit.
